skill.name: Maven Build Lifecycle Execution
skill.description: Execute Maven build phases and manage phase transitions in correct sequence. Use this skill when running builds, understanding build lifecycle flow, or coordinating phase execution.
skill.skill_body:
Invoke this skill when you need to execute Maven build phases in the correct order. The skill guides phase sequencing and ensures build artifacts are produced as expected. Do not use this for plugin development, repository configuration, or Maven settings management.

## Objective

Execute Maven build lifecycle phases in correct sequence and produce expected build artifacts
## Applicable Signals

- Maven project ready for compilation or packaging
- Build phase transition required
- Artifact production expected at specific lifecycle stage

## Contraindications

- Do not use when developing custom Maven plugins
- Do not use for repository access configuration
- Do not use for Maven settings or profile management

## Workflow Steps

- Verify Maven project structure and POM validity
- Identify target build lifecycle phase
- Execute Maven build command with appropriate phase
- Monitor phase execution sequence
- Verify expected artifacts are produced

## Constraints

- Maven project structure must be valid
- POM file must be present and well-formed
- Build phases must be executed in documented lifecycle order

## Cautions

- Phase execution order is strict; skipping phases may produce incomplete artifacts
- Ensure dependencies are resolved before execution phases

## Output Contract

- Build completes through intended lifecycle phases with expected artifacts produced and available for downstream use
